LanguageData.Gun_Glock_17L_RWP.label: Glock 17L
LanguageData.Gun_Glock_17L_RWP.description: "The Glock 17L is a long-barreled variant of the popular Glock 17 pistol. Renowned for its accuracy and reliability, this semi-automatic handgun excels in medium-range engagements. Its extended barrel offers improved ballistic performance, making it a favored choice for marksmen requiring superior precision in a compact package. Though it lacks the stopping power of larger firearms, its rapid rate of fire and manageable recoil make it a versatile sidearm in any colony's arsenal."
